content: {"phoneNote":"The hero card works, but the phone number and directions in the header duplicate the fixed bottom bar, and the team section is a near-empty block with just one name.","desktopNote":"The hero is handsome, yet the team section is a huge headline over a single name with a dead right half, and the menu band has empty space below the prices.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Cut the 'Kdo skrbi za peč in mize' section to a small line in the contact block or add a photo of the staff/oven; a giant heading over one name is a dead band.","Drop the phone/directions row under the phone header; the fixed bar already carries both, and the header on desktop already shows the number.","Tighten the dark menu band (less bottom padding, smaller prices) and add a pizza photo so the food, not the dough still-life, carries the page."],"blockers":[]}
